name: Heatwave Disturbance
description: Ambient heatwave in Delhi NCR elevates non-EV baseline residential AC load by 18% and accelerates battery HVAC load during daytime commutes.

name: Cloud Cover Solar Drop
description: Sudden cloud cover reduces rooftop and feeder PV output by 40%, shrinking midday green charging window and elevating midday grid stress.

name: Public Hub Outage
description: Feeder line maintenance knocks out Aerocity Supercharger Plaza, forcing the planner to reroute airport EVs to nearby Saket or Dwarka hubs.

name: Dynamic Peak Tariff Surge
description: DISCOM triggers emergency ToU tariff revision from ₹9.8/kWh to ₹14.7/kWh between 18:00 and 22:00 to suppress feeder overload.
